
# **Tipping Study - pt.1 load & refactor data**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{R}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)
```

#### Data

```{R}
read_and_clean <- function(path) {
  dt <- fread(path)
  dt <- dt[-c(seq(2, 8, 2))] # rm duplicate header rows
  dt[, "_io" := NULL] # don't know what this is or why it's there
  dt <- dt[practicing != TRUE] # drop practice trials
  dt[, practicing := NULL] # drop practice lag


gbyk_files <- list.files(
  path = here::here("data", "raw"),
  pattern = "*GBYK*",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

left_hand_files <- list.files(
  path = here::here("data", "raw"),
  pattern = "*LeftHand*",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

all_hand_files <- list.files(
  path = here::here("data", "raw"),
  pattern = "*all*",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

right_hand_files <- right_hand_files[!grepl("Left", right_hand_files)]
left_hand_files <- left_hand_files[!grepl("Right", left_hand_files)]

right_hand_data <- rbindlist(lapply(right_hand_files, read.csv))

left_hand_data <- rbindlist(lapply(left_hand_files, read_and_clean))

dt <- rbindlist(list(right_hand_data, left_hand_data))
```


Refactor
---

#### Type conversion

```{R}
numerics <- c(
  "pos_x", "pos_y", "pos_z",
  "frame", "trial_num", "block_num"
)

factors <- c(
  "left_right_hand", "palm_back_hand",
  "target_loc", "distractor_loc",
  "participant_id"
)

convert_columns <- function(dt, numerics, factors) {
  dt[, (numerics) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = numerics]
  dt[, (factors) := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = factors]
}

# convert_columns(righthand, numerics, factors)
# convert_columns(lefthand, numerics, factors)
convert_columns(dt, numerics, factors)
```

#### Drop practice blocks

Task demands (which hand, which side) were blocked, and each were preceded by a brief practice block.

Conveniently, this means that practice blocks are always odd-numbered.

```{R}
dt <- dt[block_num %% 2 == 0]
```

#### Spread markers

Originally long, with markers separated by row (5 / frame)

```{R}
dt[, marker_id := rep_len(1:5, .N)]

dt <- dcast(dt, ... ~ marker_id, value.var = c("pos_x", "pos_y", "pos_z"))

new_labels <- c()
for (p in c("x", "y", "z")) {
  for (i in 1:5) {
    new_labels <- c(new_labels, paste0("m", i, "_", p))
  }
}

setnames(dt, 9:23, new_labels)
```

#### Rescale data from meters to millimeters

Before anyone gets too excited, no, Optitrack cannot report to 17 decimals.
For scale, a proton's radius is ~0.8^-15 meters.

```{R}
to_rescale <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt))

dt[,
  (to_rescale) := lapply(.SD, \(col) col * 100),
  .SDcols = to_rescale
]
```


#### Check for missing data

No marker observations reported missing. Opti certainly interpolating markers.

```{R}
sum(dt[, rowSums(.SD == 0) > 0, .SDcols = patterns("_x$|_y$|_z$")])
```


#### Check for missing frames

Ideally each trial should possess 240 frames. Recorded frames largely in agreement.
Approx 97% are within 15 frames (~= 126 ms)

```{R}
group_cols <- c("participant_id", "trial_num", "block_num")

framerates <- dt[, .(frames = nrow(.SD)), by = group_cols]

pclih(framerates$frames)

summary(framerates$frames)

m <- mean(abs(framerates$frames - 240)) # ~ 6.6
s <- sd(framerates$frames) # ~ 16

mean(framerates$frames %between% c(240 - s, 240)) # ~ 0.88
mean(framerates$frames %between% c(240 - s * 2, 240)) # ~ 0.92
mean(framerates$frames %between% c(240 - s * 3, 240)) # ~ 0.95
```


#### Make frames relative & add time column

```{R}
dt[, rel_frame := seq_len(.N), by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)]
dt[, time := rel_frame / 120]
```
